Club Service Project Report – Ganpati Hopping

Project Name: Ganpati Hopping – Celebrating Faith, Culture and Fellowship
Project Dates: 14th September to 25th September
Project Reach: 275 Ganpati Mandals
Project Category: Club Service / Fellowship / Cultural Engagement

Project Overview

Rotary Club of Mumbai Pioneers undertook a special Ganpati Hopping initiative from 14th September to 25th September, covering 275 Ganpati Mandals across Mumbai. The initiative celebrated the spirit of Ganesh Chaturthi, one of Maharashtra’s most cherished festivals, while encouraging fellowship, cultural appreciation and community bonding among club members.

Project Objectives

To celebrate the auspicious festival of Lord Ganesha and promote cultural traditions.

To strengthen fellowship and camaraderie among Rotary members.

To visit and appreciate the creativity, devotion and social messages presented by different Ganpati Mandals.

To encourage unity, positivity and community engagement through share
